svg.title: AMIGA experimental design: five phases
svg.desc: Design schematic of AMIGA Study 1 at commit f31d550b2e66d8459f143e0f39eaa20aabc028b9. Five scientific phases, not a literal execution DAG. Glyphs, candidate bars and tables are schematic; no empirical results are plotted. Study 2 and prediction costs are outside scope. Generated from Python, not a raster reference.
svg.text: Choose how to rank. Test on held-out topologies. Vary the amount of labelled data.

g.text: Two generators, the same benchmark problems
Analyze each generator separately, not as 208 independent networks.
Keep topology groups together across nested splits
Repeat the complete protocol for every outer split.
Translate known network quality into learning targets.
Keep one label scheme per learner
Regression and classification use fixed targets.
Score each setting on 3 inner folds
Keep parameters for each learner × task
Same search policy for each supervised formulation.
Remove less useful predictors using training data.
Columns retained from the original table
Inner validation chooses the retained fraction
Relearn the selected column mask before outer evaluation.
Refit selected procedures; predict before reading test quality labels.
Separate panel: objective-only rules + exact random reference
The AUPR oracle is a nondeployable ceiling, not a competitor.
Regret@5 primary · Friedman + Holm, per generator
No seed selection or prediction ensemble; all five final seeds contribute.
Keep the AMIGA recipe and exact feature columns from phase 4.
Fixed model family · labels · parameters · exact columns
3 nested subset draws × 5 seeds · unchanged test folds
AMIGA only · no new model or column selection
Conditional on the recipe chosen with the full training complement.

svg.text: Selection rule: minimize missed quality among the first 5 recommendations
Regret@5 → Regret@1 → fewer columns in phase 3 → stable tie-break
Freeze the procedure for this outer split
Model family · labels · parameters · feature budget
Regret: quality missed in the top k
Study 2 (TCGA-BRCA) and prediction costs are separate analyses, not extra phases here.
Design schematic · icons and bars are illustrative, not experimental results.
